recent_posts.title: Prettier 3.8: Support for Angular v21.1 · Prettier
recent_posts.summary: Prettier 3.8 adds full support for Angular v21.1 features, including consecutive @case statements in @switch blocks and spread elements in templates. The release also enables formatting Angular syntax within Markdown code blocks and improves attribute value formatting by keeping single template or string literals inline.

recent_posts.title: Prettier 3.7: Improved formatting consistency and new plugin features! · Prettier
recent_posts.summary: Prettier 3.7 improves formatting consistency between TypeScript classes and interfaces, removing extra indentation for type parameters and aligning heritage clause formatting. The release includes numerous bug fixes across JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML, and other languages, with enhanced comment handling throughout. New features include support for Angular 21, GraphQL 16.12 executable descriptions, and Front Matter in Handlebars. Plugin developers gain new APIs for comment attachment control and handling ignored nodes through `canAttachComment()` ancestors parameter and `printPrettierIgnored()` function.

recent_posts.title: Prettier 3.6: Experimental fast CLI and new OXC and Hermes plugins! · Prettier
recent_posts.summary: Prettier 3.6 introduces an experimental high-performance CLI accessible via the --experimental-cli flag, along with two new official plugins: @prettier/plugin-oxc for faster JavaScript/TypeScript parsing using Rust-based OXC parser, and @prettier/plugin-hermes for Flow syntax support. The release includes numerous bug fixes and improvements across JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML, and other supported languages, with the Hermes plugin planned to become the default Flow parser in v4.

recent_posts.title: Prettier 3.5: New objectWrap option, experimentalOperatorPosition option and TS config file support! · Prettier
recent_posts.summary: Prettier 3.5 introduces new features including support for the objectWrap option, the experimentalOperatorPosition option, and TypeScript configuration files. This release aims to address long-standing formatting issues while adhering to Prettier's option philosophy. Additionally, there are several improvements and fixes in the handling of various languages and configurations, such as JSX, Flow, CSS, Vue, Angular, Ember/Handlebars, Markdown, and JSONC syntax in package.json for Bun.

recent_posts.title: Prettier 3.4: A lot of bug fixes · Prettier
recent_posts.summary: Prettier 3.4 introduces numerous bug fixes and improvements across various languages including JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, SCSS, HTML, Vue, Angular, Markdown, and YAML. Key updates include fixes for template literals, comment formatting, support for top-level await statements, and improved handling of various syntax and comments. The release also addresses issues with extra indentation, trailing commas in SCSS, and proper formatting in markdown documents.

recent_posts.title: Prettier 3.4: A lot of bug fixes · Prettier
recent_posts.summary: Prettier 3.4 introduces numerous bug fixes and improvements across various languages and formats. Key changes include better handling of template literals in JavaScript, improved comment formatting in TypeScript, refined string literal escapes, and enhanced formatting for CSS, SCSS, HTML, and Markdown. Notably, experimental syntax support was removed, and several bug fixes aimed at maintaining formatting consistency were implemented.

recent_posts.title: Prettier 3.3: New Flow features and a lot of bug fixes · Prettier
recent_posts.summary: Prettier 3.3 introduces new Flow features, including support for component and hook declarations, big int enums, inexact tuple types, and the 'implies' type guard variant. Additional improvements include enhanced JavaScript formatting, TypeScript fixes, better handling of markdown/mdx code blocks, and support for 'package.yaml' configuration.

recent_posts.title: Prettier 3.3: New Flow features and a lot of bug fixes · Prettier
recent_posts.summary: Prettier 3.3 includes support for new Flow features, bug fixes, and options for sponsorship.

recent_posts.title: Prettier 3.2: Support JSONC and Angular’s ICU expression · Prettier
recent_posts.summary: Prettier 3.2 introduces a new JSONC parser and support for Angular's ICU expressions, enhancing its capabilities. There are bug fixes and improvements across JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, Ember/Handlebars, and GraphQL. Feedback is sought for the experimental ternaries option introduced in Prettier 3.1. A new, faster CLI is also expected in version 4.0.

recent_posts.title: Prettier 3.2: Support JSONC and Angular’s ICU expression · Prettier
recent_posts.summary: Prettier 3.2 adds support for JSONC and Angular's ICU expressions, and includes bug fixes. Feedback is still being sought for the `--experimental-ternaries` option in Prettier 3.1. Check out Prettier's CLI: A Performance Deep Dive for a faster CLI experience. Sponsorship options are available for supporting Prettier's work.
